newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dickson up on S.T. Dupont listing plan.
newsitem.headline: Dickson up on S.T. Dupont listing plan.

text.p: Shares of Dickson Concepts (International) Ltd rose to an all-time high of HK$29.40 in Thursday morning trade following news that the company plans to list its S.T. Dupont subsidiary on the Paris stock exchange.
The shares later eased to HK$29.00, up HK$0.80.
"Expectations of an exceptional gain following the listing of its unit boosted demand for the shares," said Sean Li, associate director at Amsteel Securities.
Analysts said the listing would also benefit the company in the longer term since it would enable Dickson to raise funds on other stock exchanges.

The Hong Kong-based retailer said on Wednesday it planned to list its S.T. Dupont subsidiary on the Paris stock exchange, with a global offering possible in early December. The initial market capitalisation would be about HK$1.7-1.8 billion.
